STATUSOFSUBSCRIPTIONFORTHERIGHTISSUE-GHANIGLASSLIMITED
In compliance of clause 7 of the“Procedure tobe complied with for issue of right shares”
provided in your letter No. PSX/C-939-2434 dated December 23, 2020, we are pleased to inform
you that the Right Issue of Ghani Glass Ltd amounting Rs. 2,978,484,660 has been subscribed by
99.78 % as of the last date of payment & acceptance of shares i.e. February 26, 2021. As per the
detail received from theBankers to the issue,MeezanBank Ltd,the total amount subscribed is
Rupees 2,971,932,840.
